There's no possibility of evacuation. Aah! They've taken General Ropal and the holocron memory crystal.|The clone|}} A '''clone trooper''' served the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He served under [[Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal]], the keeper of the [[Kyber memory crystal]] that contained a list of [[Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling|children]] across [[the galaxy]]. In [[21 BBY]], he took part in a [[Battle of Devaron|battle]] on the [[planet]] [[Devaron]] when the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] attacked with the Separatist [[Trade Federation fleet]] in hopes of capturing the [[Jedi]] and the crystal. When their outpost was overrun, the trooper informed [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] that Ropal had been abducted by the Separatist forces before being [[Death|killed]] by a [[B1-series battle droid]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Do you know where they've taken them?''"
"''Sorry, sir. We tried to stop them, but they've left the outpost.|Anakin Skywalker and the clone, before the latter's death|}} [[Cloning|Created]] from the [[DNA]] of [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] alongside fellow clones on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]], the clone joined the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] to serve the [[Galactic Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The clone was eventually stationed at an [[Devaron New Republic outpost|outpost]] on the planet [[Devaron]] under [[Jedi General]] [[Bolla Ropal]], the keeper of the [[Kyber memory crystal]], which contained a list of [[Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling|children]] in [[the galaxy]]. In [[21 BBY]], the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]] traveled with the Separatist [[Trade Federation fleet]] to the planet to capture [[Jedi Master]] Ropal and the crystal. The outpost was [[Battle of Devaron|overrun]] and Ropal was captured and dragged out of the outpost with the crystal. With no possibility for evacuation, the clone sent an urgent transmission to [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Resolute]]'' via [[hologram]]. [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]] informed Skywalker of the transmission and the [[Jedi Knight]] left the [[Star Destroyer]]'s [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] to view the transmission. [[File:CloneTrooperChoked-CoD.png|thumb|right|300px|The clone trooper is grabbed by a battle droid.]] In a firefight, the clone informed Skywalker of the situation they were in as they were shot in their shoulder. Reporting Ropal's capture, a [[B1-series battle droid]] grabbed on to the [[Clone trooper|trooper's]] [[DC-15A blaster carbine]] before he shoved it off and blasted it. Skywalker asked the [[trooper]] if he knew where Ropal was being taken, and with a delayed response, he apologized and told Skywalker of their attempt to stop them and that they left the outpost. Before he could say anything else, another B1 [[battle droid]] grabbed his [[helmet]] and wrapped its [[Limb|arm]] around the trooper's neck from behind, [[Death|killing]] the [[soldier]]. The transmitter was destroyed shortly after. ==Personality and traits== Identical to all clones of Jango Fett, the trooper had [[Color|tan]] skin, weighed eighty [[kilogram]]s, and stood at 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|ft]]) tall. ==Skills and abilities== Along with fellow clones, he was trained in both unarmed and armed combat with a [[blaster]]. ==Equipment== At birth, like all clones, the [[Kaminoan]] [[scientist]]s implanted a [[behavioral modification biochip]] in his [[brain]] to ensure obedience. The trooper wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] over a black [[body glove]] and utilized a DC-15A [[blaster carbine]]. ==Behind the scenes== The clone appeared via hologram in "[[Cargo of Doom]]," the second episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which aired on [[October 9]], [[2009]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'' The trooper was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voiced all other clones in the series. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified clone trooper (Devaron)}} *{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}} {{1st}} {{Hologram}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
